status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

marketMarginals.top2: normalize inverse official JRA quinella odds to race mass 1, then sum incident pair probabilities for each horse; horse marginals sum to 2
marketMarginals.top3: normalize inverse official JRA wide lower-bound odds to race mass 3, sum incident pair probabilities for each horse and divide by 2; horse marginals sum to 3

horseModels.type: LightGBM binary market-residual ensemble with corresponding horse marginal logit as init_score
horseModels.ensemble: same three fixed equal-weight residual configurations as 164-feature win model; no ROI-based tuning

pairCorrection.quinella: official pair market probability multiplied by sqrt((OOS top2 marginal / market top2 marginal) for horse A * same for horse B), then renormalized to race mass 1
pairCorrection.wide: official pair market probability multiplied by sqrt((OOS top3 marginal / market top3 marginal) for horse A * same for horse B), then renormalized to race mass 3

ticketScore: corrected pair probability multiplied by corresponding JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound for ranking
